verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation ships general-purpose sandboxing primitives (GNOME Boxes for VMs, container tools) that a user could repurpose to spin up an isolated test environment, but there is no AI-native framing, no documented workflow for testing against a sandbox instead of production data, and no independent corroboration of this use case. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/test-vs-production workflow, AI-agent integration, hands-on evidence of this specific use case.
